name: gamesim
description: Gamesim — notebook player + admin operator + API server

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,player -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:player"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,player,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:player" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:player
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --prefix shared/finlit-engine && npm run build --prefix shared/api-contract
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:player && npm run build:admin
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:server && npm run test:admin:ci
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd shared/finlit-engine && npm install && npm run build && cd ../api-contract && npm install && npm run build && cd ../../server && npm install && cd ../notebook-pixel-sim && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.start:server:ci: cd server && PORT=5001 npm run dev
